note: one-hop runs once per (size, rep), not per cell, and is reused across all chain queries (hops) at that size since the hop table is the same. Per-run query results (hop.csv, sgx_app output) are tempdir-owned and discarded after parsing. AML chain queries are anchored per dataset (a1.bank_id substituted from the size table). full_mwj_no_filter runs sgx_app with --no-filter and explodes with dataset size; both full-MWJ variants are gated by --full-mwj-max-edges. Any binary OOM/crash/timeout is caught per cell (recorded output_rows=OOM/TIMEOUT, total_ms empty) and never aborts the sweep; once a system fails at hop K for a dataset, that dataset's higher hops are SKIPPED, and once a full-MWJ system fails at E edges, larger sizes are SKIPPED.
